summary: Stewards, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a promissory note with FAVO Holdings, a related-party holder owned by its CEO and a director. The amendment extends the maturity of a $1.6 million final installment to September 1, 2026, sets 10% simple interest, and temporarily waives default interest. It also adopted amended bylaws. No special-situation event occurs; this is a routine debt modification and governance update.
